test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is **"Pleasurre".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"pleasure".**
 
• The incorrect spelling in option 1 has an extra **"r".**
 
• The correct pronunciation is "pleh-zhur".
 
• **"Pleasure"** means a feeling of enjoyment or satisfaction. (प्रसन्‍नता या संतुष्टि)
 
 
• **Example**: *Parents get a lot of **pleasure**__ out of watching their children grow up.*
 
 
 
• ​The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"Slogan"**, is spelt correctly and means a memorable phrase used in advertising or politics. ((राजनीतिक व्‍यवहार या विज्ञापन की भाषा में प्रयुक्त) नारा; स्‍लोगन (एक छोटा वाक्‍यांश जिसे याद करना सरल हो))
 
• Option 3, **"Heaven"**, is spelt correctly and refers to the place believed to be the ultimate afterlife destination in many religions. (स्‍वर्ग; कुछ धर्मों की मान्‍यता के अनुसार ईश्‍वर का निवासस्‍थान जँहा मृत्यु के बाद अच्छी आत्माऐं जाती हैं)
 
• Option 4, **"Brinjal"**, is spelt correctly and is another name for the vegetable known as eggplant. (बैंगन)
